p: when it was determined that we: Paul, with many other prisoners and through the midst of many deaths, is brought to Rome, but yet by God's own hand as it were, and set forth and commended to the world with many singular testimonies.
Salmone: Which was a high hill of Crete.
Now when much time was spent: God's providence does not take away the causes which God uses as means, but rather orders and disposes their right use, even when he reveals an extraordinary issue.

fast was now already past: This refers to the Jews fast which they kept in the feast of expiation, as we read in Le 23:17, which fell in the seventh month which we call October, and is not good for navigating or sailing.

Nevertheless the centurion believed the master: Men cast themselves willingly into an infinite amount of dangers, when they choose to follow their own wisdom, rather than God, when he speaks by the mouth of his servants.
it a tempestuous wind: By Crete, from whose shore our ship was driven by that means.
Euroclydon: Northeast wind.
And we being exceedingly tossed with: The result proves that none provide worse for themselves than those who commit themselves to be governed only by their own wisdom.
But after long abstinence Paul stood: God spares the wicked for a time, for the sake of his elect and chosen.
Wherefore: The promise is made effectual through faith.
But when the fourteenth night was: We attain and come to the promised and sure salvation through the midst of tempests and death itself.
Adria: For Ptolemy writes that the Adriatic Sea beats upon the east shore of Cecilia.
that they drew near to some: Or, some country drew near to them.
And as the shipmen were about: No matter how foul the act, distrust and an evil conscience can always compel men to commit it.

Paul said to the centurion and: Although the performing of God's promises does not depend upon secondary causes, yet they make themselves unworthy of God's bountifulness who do not embrace those means which God offers them, either upon rashness or distrust.
And while the day was coming: When the world trembles, the faithful alone are not only at peace, but strengthen and encourage others by their example.
hair fall from the head of: This is a proverb which the Hebrews use, by which is meant that they will be safe, and that not one of them will perish.
And when it was day: Then are tempests most of all to be feared and looked for, when the port or haven is nearest.
creek with a shore: A creek is a sea within land, as the Adriatic Sea, and the Persian Sea.
two seas met: So is an isthmus called, because the Sea touches it on both sides.
And the soldiers' counsel was to: There is nowhere more unfaithfulness and unthankfulness in unbelievers.
But the centurion: God finds even amongst his enemies those whose help he uses to preserve his own.
And the rest: The goodness of God overcomes man's malice.
